title: Cylinder amplitudes and logarithmic bridge-length windows on the honeycomb lattice
summary: We prove a logarithmic window of critical honeycomb bridge lengths: summed through height $`2h(\log h)^{1/64}`$, bridges of lengths between $`h^{4/3}(\log h)^{-1/8}`$ and $`2h^{4/3}(\log h)^{1/2}`$ have mass at least $`h^{3/4}(\log h)^{-C}`$.
family_title: The three-quarter exponent for honeycomb self-avoiding walk

review.reason: Proves a logarithmic window of critical honeycomb bridge lengths with explicit mass bounds.
